title: IQGS: Instance Query-based Gaussian Segmentation

layout.note: Five dashed panels in three columns: (a) tall at the left, (b) over (c) in the wide middle column as mirrored lanes, (d) over (e) at the right as pairs of renders. Every panel has a bold title underneath.

lesson: Draw competing paradigms as mirrored lanes with identical boxes so that only the loss label and the supervision arrows differ, then follow them with output renders that carry the metric on the image to prove the failure.
